versions.content: Definition of initial value for data transmission Initial values for sender/receiver-based data transmission (i.e. intra-Ecu as well as inter-Ecu) shall only be defined by means of NonqueuedSenderComSpec . initValue resp. Non- queuedReceiverComSpec . initValue . Any definition of an initValue defined in the context of VariableDataPrototype shall be ignored.
